The '''''Chokehold''''' was an [[Immobilizer 418 Interdictor-class Heavy Cruiser|Immobilizer 418 cruiser]] that was used by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] during the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==History==
During the Galactic Civil War, the ''Chokehold'' was stationed near to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dac/Legends|Mon Calamari]], to try and capture [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[Starship/Legends|starships]] that were assisting members of the [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] [[Species/Legends|species]] in fleeing from the Imperial occupation of their [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]].<ref name="Scum and Villainy" />

When a group of freelance agents attempted to travel to the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Phinel's Folly]], their [[Starship/Legends|ship]] was caught in the ''Chokehold''{{'s}} [[Gravity well/Legends|gravity well]] and brought out of [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]]. The agents were then ordered by the crew of the ''Chokehold'' to cut their engines, while the [[Cruiser/Legends|cruiser's]] [[Tractor beam/Legends|tractor beam]] pulled their craft into its [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]].<ref name="Scum and Villainy" />
